meetings.title: Acme pilot scoping
meetings.summary: Acme wants a 6-week pilot of Project Bluebird starting mid-October. Their ops lead (wanjiru@acme.example, +254 712 345 678) asked for a revised scope with fewer integrations. Decision: drop the CRM integration from phase 1.

meetings.title: Acme intro call
meetings.summary: Intro call. Acme's main pain point is manual weekly reporting across 4 branches. Agreed to send a case study.

meetings.title: Globex pilot check-in
meetings.summary: Project Heron pilot is in week 2. Adoption is good in Nairobi, weak in Mombasa. Decision: run a refresher session for the Mombasa team next week.

meetings.title: Initech pricing discussion
meetings.summary: Initech pushed back on per-seat pricing for Project Kestrel. Decision: present Option B (flat monthly fee with a usage cap) because their headcount fluctuates seasonally. Contact: 0722 000 111.
